16647.description:
In the game, he plays as a strong character nearing the level cap. However, in real life, Lu Siqi is a highschooler with nothing left to live for. Only thinking about what is the meaning of being alive and death.
Operating as a meek female character in the game, in reality, Shi Liu is a self proclaimed sentient beast who is finding his next interesting prey behind the monitor screen.
The new update in《Fantasy ONLINE》added many new high level equips in the medium difficulty instance "Deville Labyrinth", which attracted many players to form groups.
Just like that, 647 who is planning to challege the instance, and Sixteen_16 who is looking for a new prey, met each other at the entrance of the instance—(Source: Creative Comic, translated)

berserk.description:
His name is Guts, the Black Swordsman, a feared warrior spoken of only in whispers. Bearer of a gigantic sword, an iron hand, and the scars of countless battles and tortures, his flesh is also indelibly marked with The Brand, an unholy symbol that draws the forces of darkness to him and dooms him as their sacrifice. But Guts won't take his fate lying down; he'll cut a crimson swath of carnage through the ranks of the damned—and anyone else foolish enough to oppose him! Accompanied by Puck the Elf, more an annoyance than a companion, Guts relentlessly follows a dark, bloodstained path that leads only to death...or vengeance.

(Source: Dark Horse)

Notes:
- Volumes 1-5 contain the 16 prequel chapters 0A - 0P.
- Chapter 83 was omitted from Volume 13 due to the author’s request.
- Volume 14 includes “Berserk: The Prototype”.
- Due to the author's passing, starting from Chapter 365, the manga is illustrated by Studio Gaga (Miura's assistants) and supervised by Kouji Mori (a close friend of Miura's).

blue-box.description:
Taiki Inomata is on the boys' badminton team at sports powerhouse Eimei Junior and Senior High. He's in love with basketball player Chinatsu Kano, the older girl he trains alongside every morning in the gym. One Spring day, their relationship takes a sharp turn ... And thus begins this brand-new series of love, sports and youth!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

chainsaw-man.description:
The name says it all! Denji's life of poverty is changed forever when he merges with his pet chainsaw dog, Pochita! Now he's living in the big city and an official Devil Hunter. But he's got a lot to learn about his new job and chainsaw powers!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Notes:
- Nominated for the 2020 Manga Taisho Award.
- Winner of the 2021 Kono Manga ga Sugoi Award.
- Winner of the 66th Shogakukan Manga Award in the shounen category.
- Winner of the 2021 and 2022 Harvey Award for Best Manga.
- Chapters 1-97 were released in Weekly Shounen Jump from Dec 3, 2018 to Dec 13, 2020. The series resumed from Ch. 98 in Shounen Jump+ on July 12, 2022

solo-leveling.description:
In a world where awakened beings called “Hunters” must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Seong Jin-U, nicknamed “the weakest hunter of all mankind,” finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jin-U has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jin-U’s journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

title.native: 東京喰種 トーキョーグール

tokyo-ghoul.description:
Shy Ken Kaneki is thrilled to go on a date with the beautiful Rize. But it turns out that she’s only interested in his body—eating it, that is. When a morally questionable rescue transforms him into the first half-human half-Ghoul hybrid, Ken is drawn into the dark and violent world of Ghouls, which exists alongside our own.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

vagabond.description:
At seventeen years of age, Miyamoto Musashi--still known by his childhood name, Shinmen Takezo--was a wild young brute just setting out along the way of the sword.

In the aftermath of the epic Battle of Sekigahara, Takezo finds himself a fugitive survivor on the losing side of the war. Takezo's vicious nature has made him an outcast even in his own village, and he is hunted down like an animal. At this crucial crossroads in Takezo's life, an eccentric monk and a childhood friend are the only ones who can help him find his way.

(Source: VIZ Media)

jujutsu-kaisen.description:
Although Yuji Itadori looks like your average teenager, his immense physical strength is something to behold! Every sports club wants him to join, but Itadori would rather hang out with the school outcasts in the Occult Research Club. One day, the club manages to get their hands on a sealed cursed object. Little do they know the terror they’ll unleash when they break the seal…

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes:
- Ranked 1st in Japan's Bookstore Employees Top Manga of 2018.
- Nominated for the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2021.
- Nominated for the 65th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2019.
- Includes one extra chapter.

goodnight-punpun.description:
Meet Punpun Punyama. He’s an average kid in an average town.
He wants to win a Nobel Prize and save the world.
He wants the girl he has a crush on to like him back.
He wants to find some porn.
That’s what he wants, but what does he get…?

(Source: VIZ Media)

vinland-saga.description:
As a child, Thorfinn sat at the feet of the great Leif Ericson and thrilled to wild tales of a land far to the west. But his youthful fantasies were shattered by a mercenary raid. Raised by the Vikings who murdered his father, Thorfinn became a terrifying warrior, forever seeking to kill the band's leader, Askeladd, and avenge his father. Sustaining Thorfinn through his ordeal are his pride in his family and his dreams of a fertile westward land, a land without war or slavery … the land Leif called Vinland.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Notes:
- Includes the one-shot "Sayonara ga Chikai no de" (For Our Farewell Is Near)
- Includes the one-shot "Assassin's Creed: Valhalla x Vinland Saga"
- Includes two extra chapters.
- Won the Grand Prize at the Japan Media Arts Festival in 2009.
- Winner of the 36th Kodansha Manga Award in the General category in 2012.

20th-century-boys.description:
Humanity, having faced extinction at the end of the 20th century, would not have entered the new millennium if it weren't for them. In 1969, during their youth, they created a symbol. In 1997, as the coming disaster slowly starts to unfold, that symbol returns. This is the story of a group of boys who try to save the world.

For Kenji, a simple convenience store manager who once dreamed of becoming a rock 'n' roll musician, a host of memories from his past come rushing back when one of his childhood friends mysteriously commits suicide. Could this new death be related to the rise of a bizarre new cult that's been implicated in several other murders and disappearances? Determined to dig deeper, Kenji reunites with some of his old buddies in the hope of learning the truth behind it all.

(Source: VIZ Media)

roses-and-champagne.description:
Lee-Won, who works as a poor lawyer in Russia, visits City Councilor Zdanov, who is in conflict over Nikolai's commission, and there he meets the mafia boss, Caesar. Behind City Councilor Zdanov, there was a mafia involved. The meeting between the two is extraordinary.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes 38 extra chapters.

blood-link.description:
A human, lycan, or a vampire - what am I?! Completely unaware of the existence of these predators, Hwa-Gok goes about his everyday life... That is, until Lee-Bin turns his life upside down by biting him on the neck, setting off a whirlwind of events neither of them could foresee.

(Source: Lezhin US)

taming-the-tiger.description:
Ahn Geum-hoo needs a butcher to provide fresh animal blood for his sickly brother’s medicine. While most of the butchers seem reluctant to provide him with what he needs, Nobody is willing to do Geum-hoo’s bidding. With striking features and a strong build, Nobody has quite a reputation amongst the village folk. Yet, Geum-hoo finds a way to tame this wild tiger. First, he gives him a name—Beom. Then, he invites him to a world that this nobody’s never experienced...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

yandere-top-father.description:
“What role did I play in this novel? I want to know what kind of relationship I had with Chae Seung-Yeon.”

Seung-Yeon is possessed by the father of the obsessive maniac in the run-down BL novel written by his younger sister. Woo-Jin, the father of the main character, saves Seung-Yeon when he is in danger of death. Seung-Yeon realizes that he and Woo-Jin are in-laws, but as time passes, their relationship somehow flows differently from the original story…

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

smyrna-and-capri.description:
What if your sworn enemy holds the key to your future? Theo Peserus: an alpha of the mighty Peserus clan, called forth to provide the clan with a child. For a tree to bear fruit, a worthy Capri must be chosen to inseminate him. Seram Marita: a revolutionary army soldier hailing from the Langeres clan. Having escaped from his imprisonment, he now weaves through the maze-like halls of the Peserus castle, looking for a way out. But a tempting odor permeates the air and leads Seram straight to the enemy. Intoxicated on pheromones, the two adversaries are now engaged, not in a battle for their lives, but in a war of lust... What fruit will come to bear when these foes, this Smyrna and this Capri, become entangled in a decadence that they both cannot resist…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

no-littering.description:
Kwon Ji-Hyeok, a good-for-nothing who’s lived his whole life relying solely on the handsome face he inherited from his parents, finds himself kicked out of his girlfriend’s house with nowhere else to go. While wandering in search of his next place to freeload, he stumbles upon a mansion with its door left open and decides to sneak in. But inside, he’s greeted by the horrifying sight of a dismembered corpse. Sensing imminent doom, he tries to escape, only for the missing homeowner to appear right then and there. One look is all it takes for Ji-Hyeok to realize it: this guy definitely has the face of a serial killer.

For someone who’s always coasted through life on his looks, this is the biggest crisis he’s ever faced. To survive, Ji-Hyeok might have to pull his most desperate move yet, using his charm to seduce this psychopathic killer. Because if he fails, it won’t just be his pride that gets pierced.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

kiss-me-liar.description:
Yeonwoo is a perfectly competent secretary. However, he’s secretly in love with his boss, an extreme alpha named Keith, who has zero interest in male omegas. After a traumatic incident leaves Yeonwoo fearful of all alphas but Keith, he resigns to hide at home. Keith, inconvenienced by the absence of his trusty secretary, takes on the task of helping Yeonwoo recover. Will proximity and pheromones cause love to blossom in this working relationship?

(Source: Tapas)

struggle.description:
What if one little misunderstanding led to the biggest mistake of your life? Lee Kang, dominant alpha and the heir to the Se-ryong foundation, first helps out Yeo Juheon because he feels sorry for him. But the more he gets to know him and the closer they get, Kang starts to fall for the beta for real. They could be a thing, or so Kang thought… His whole world comes crumbling down when he finds out Juheon is already someone else’s. That’s already 7 years ago now, but Kang’s still reeling from the hurt… until he figures out maybe he was in the wrong after all. After years of hurt and misunderstanding, can Kang find his way back to the love of his life?

(Source: Lezhin US)

non-refundable-alpha.description:
Choi Jae-Won was living a carefree life abroad, surrounded by playful alphas and chasing nothing but pleasure. But when his father lures him back to Korea, he’s blindsided by a wedding—his own. The groom turns out to be Yang Joon-Hee, a childhood friend who’s grown into everything Jae-Won’s ever wanted. And before he can make sense of it, the vows are already said. Joon-Hee insists they once made a promise. Jae-Won doesn’t remember it... but something in him starts to respond anyway.

(Source: Lezhin US)

dirty-desire.description:
Seong-Yul has spent years pining for his older brother’s friend, Seung-Won. But as a beta from a humble background, he knows a future with the elite alpha is impossible. When a sudden secondary gender manifestation turns Seong-Yul into an omega, his life spirals. Desperate for cash and heartbroken by news of Seung-Won’s engagement, he makes a reckless choice to enter the underground adult industry. His first night is a nightmare...until his very first client turns out to be Seung-Won himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Include one extra chapter.

forget-my-wife-try-me.description:
Yin Tae-Rim, CEO of a failing company, turns to Seo Yi-Rin, a powerful executive with a reputation for sponsoring the lovers she takes a liking to. Desperate to save his business, he makes his move, but Yi-Rin already has a new “puppy” to play with and shows no interest. Instead, she passes him along. Not to a colleague. Not to a rival. To her husband.

That’s how Tae-Rim ends up in front of Jin Ha-Kyung, the cold and unreadable head of a major company. Ha-Kyung listens, watching him squirm through an awkward explanation. Then, with a slow smile tugging at his lips, he makes a proposal that stops Tae-Rim cold.

"Forget my wife. Try me."

(Source: Lezhin US)

love-on-hold.description:
Jeong-Yoon has harbored a crush on Chae-Heon all through high school and now college. Despite ‘fate’ always bringing them together, Jeong-Yoon hasn’t been able to become close to Chae-Heon, much less tell the latter about his feelings. This is mainly because he is convinced that Chae-Heon doesn’t like him. But unbeknownst to Jeong-Yoon, Chae-Heon is not without his own complaints. Will the two resolve ever their misunderstandings and will love, which has been put on hold for so long, finally begin?

(Source: Lezhin US)

netkama-punch.description:
Netkama – a male who portrays himself as female online. This is what Kim Seyeong decides to become after reencountering Shin Heejae, the guy who destroyed Seyeong’s gaming career in “Arcadia” a year prior. His plan is to pretend to be a girl in the game, get Heejae to fall for him, and then make the big reveal to everyone so that his archnemesis will also be humiliated out of “Arcadia” forever. But being a dude trying to become the girlfriend of your worst enemy is no easy feat, especially more so when said worst enemy starts to show a bit too much interest in you. Will Seyeong come out the victor of this scheme? Or will he find himself losing to Heejae all over again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

can-a-gangster-leave.description: Hyeongwon, a member of the Viper Gang, decides to leave the gang and flee the country. He still has a long way to go, but in a weak moment, he ends up having a one-night stand with  Seongjin... But who is really Seongjin?

title.english: Love History Caused by Willful Negligence

love-history-negligence.description:
Woo-Yeon is one of the brightest rising stars as a nationally beloved actor. Nobody is capable of hating such a talented and sweet man with his blessed looks. Or, well, that’s what people who don’t know the real Woo-Yeon think. In reality, Woo-Yeon is manipulative, cold-hearted, and dangerous. But his new manager In-Seob is his biggest fan, and he’s determined to stick by Woo-Yeon’s side no matter what. Except…remember how nobody in the know is capable of hating Woo-Yeon? Well, In-Seob just might know more than he lets on…

(Source: Lezhin US)

payback.description:
While other students were preparing to take their CSAT exams, Lee Yu-Han was swept up in an exhilarating lifestyle of crime and debauchery. While working for a loan shark, karma catches up to him when a family member dies from an act of revenge against him. After years of repenting for his sins and trying to turn over a new leaf, he meets a man in the entertainment industry who gives him the opportunity to get his revenge…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

love-me-not.description:
Ji-Wook’s more than used to poverty’s myriad of miseries. All his life he’s had to deal with debt, so he’s used to barely getting by. Now he’s determined to get out of this financial hell hole and when he gets into Dae-Han High school, things look like they’re taking a turn for the better. This prestigious school usually only welcomes the wealthy, but Ji-Wook managed to get in by pure grit. Now there’s nothing stopping him from his hike toward success…or is there? On his first day back to school, he somehow grabs the attention of Ju Seung-Eon, who is everything that Ji-Wook isn’t. Despite their differences, Seung-Eon starts to take a special interest in Ji-Wook. Little do they know what consequences a little curiosity will bring...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

deadman-switch.description:
We’ve all had that nightmare where we’re late for a test, right? How about the one where your teacher’s trying to kill you?! Just me, huh? Guess it’s only fair then that I woke up in an actual zombie-infested nightmare! Almost everyone on my campus has become a creepy, flesh-eating monster! Except for this one ax-wielding badass named Youngwon Ki. He seems perfectly fine with all the chaos. I’m glad he’s here, but I don’t get why he acts like we’re close!

(Source: Tapas)

bye-bye.description:
Seoyu is an extremely recessive omega who can’t believe his luck when he meets an extremely dominant alpha named Sunghoon Choi. This alpha has it all, even if he might be a gang leader! Seoyu intends to enjoy their fling for as long as he can because that’s all it is, right? Sunghoon can’t possibly be interested in being Seoyu’s boyfriend. However, he does boyfriend-like things, like having meals delivered to Seoyu’s apartment and constantly worrying that Seoyu is too cold… but surely this is just temporary!

(Source: Tapas) Note: Chapter count includes 3 side story.

exotic-love.description:
On the outside, Jeong Jaehan has it all. He’s a third-generation chaebol in charge of an incredibly successful film production company. Despite all the power and money, he’s been secretly suffering from a torturous ailment. After years of drugs and alcohol abuse, he’s lost the ability to orgasm- or so he thought. When someone from his past unexpectedly shows up, Jaehan experiences pleasure that he thought he’d lost forever...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 29 extra chapters.

origin-of-species.description:
Lee Young-Jin has never been like other Omegas. Rather than being physically superior to humans like the rest of his species, Young-Jin is a gifted hacker. But when his talent leads him to an ill-fated heist mission, Young-Jin finds himself trapped in the clutches of a powerful Alpha businessman named Seo Seung-Hyun. Now, he must do anything he can to guarantee safety for himself and his colleagues - even if it means sleeping with the enemy. But as the business deal between Young-Jin and Seung-Hyun quickly becomes more personal, will they be able to see eye to eye? Or will their differences be too much to overcome? Set in the Omegaverse.

(Source: Tappytoon)

whos-your-daddy.description:
Louis, a captain of the 2nd Guard, has been on the hunt. A hunt for the serial killer who has thrown the capital into a state of chaos for months. Having run himself ragged attempting to come up with a suspect, he ends up in the hospital. What was thought to be a simple case of being overworked, has turned out to be something else. Louis is four months pregnant. But that could only happen if a man is impregnated by one with strong royal ancestry. Four months ago was the date of the imperial ball and also when these murders started happening… But Louis can’t remember a thing… Who is behind these murders and just who the hell did he spend the night with the night of the ball?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extras.

murderous-lewellyn.description:
Life on rough, rundown Ira Street isn’t easy at the best of times, but a recent string of murders has left the residents traumatized. Not Shavonne, though. He’s too busy trying to get by to worry about some murderer. However, that all changes when he meets his peculiar new neighbor. Lewellyn is young and handsome, yet eccentric. Why does he spend all day peeling onions on the apartment stairs until his eyes are red-raw? And what’s with those filthy black fingernails? Nevertheless, Shavonne reluctantly accepts a dinner invitation at his neighbor’s place. But after he makes a gruesome discovery during the candlelit meal, suddenly the murders feel a lot closer to home…

(Source: Lezhin US)

my-bias-appeared.description:
When high school teacher Na Aejoon shows up for work on an ordinary day, he never expects to bump into his favorite celebrity in the hallway. But when his school becomes a filming location for a show starring Choi Siyeol, his bias from the idol group A-One, that’s exactly what happens!

If that’s not enough to give a fanboy a heart attack, Siyeol takes an interest in Aejoon and asks him to join the show as his “co-teacher.” Desperate to keep his fan life a secret, Aejoon is forced to put his acting skills to the test, and not just on camera. But as he spends more and more time with Siyeol, the deception becomes harder to keep up. Not to mention, he might not be the only one keeping secrets…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

my-boss-is-a-goddess.description:
In this world, there are many special, unique, and glamorous people. However, there are those who play a supporting role in these relationship dynamics. Lin Mu was one such character, where he played the role of a wallflower.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

its-my-baby.description:
'I had a one night stand with the first person I met, but I got pregnant.'

Everytime this omega had a boyfriend, the relationship always ended up with him being cheated on and in the end, he even got crushed by hearing the words, “You are an omega, but I’m not attracted to you". Hae-Su, who was chugging alcohol while raging to his friend who comforted him, got wasted on a drug, and to make matters worse, his heat cycle started. Alpha Do-Geon, who was in the same pub, notices Hae-Su's condition and tries to help Haesoo and get him away from the place but he is seduced by Hae-Su's pheromones and they end up spending the night together.

In the morning, as soon as he wakes up, Hae-Su hastily ran away and finds out that he is pregnant 4 weeks later. Hae-Su decides to raise and make the child happy by himself. After 4 years, Hae-Su and Do-Geon are reunited...

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

love-is-an-illusion.description:
Hye-sung spent his entire life believing he was an alpha, the jackpot of the genetic lottery. His world is flipped upside down when he learns that he isn’t a dominating alpha, but a submissive omega instead! His frustration redlines whenever he crosses paths with the handsome Dojin, a true alpha. Supposedly, Dojin can’t stand omegas, but sparks fly when he butts heads with Hye-sung, and their explosive arguments set off an unexpectedly spicy relationship. Is their sizzling chemistry truly just pheromones?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

how-to-snag-an-alpha.description:
Born into a family of handsome, wealthy, and well-educated alphas, Woo-Young always expected he would be the same. Come to find out, he was the odd man out as the lone omega, and not even a perfect one at that. To compensate, Woo-Young goes through life pretending to be a beta, but when he begins to experience hormone imbalances, irregular heat cycles, and a distinct lack of control over his impulses, his lowly recessive omega status becomes impossible to ignore. That’s when he meets Kyung-Ju, a powerful and successful dominant alpha who can turn him into a true omega, and also makes him weak in the knees. Now, Woo-Young must use every tactic there is to court Kyung-Ju and make the brooding alpha his very own.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 23 side story chapters.

low-tide-in-twilight.description:
Kim Eui-Hyun is an omega at his limit. After living a life of troubles and owing an unpayable debt that isn’t even his, he’s ready to give up. Hoping to spare himself and his little brother a life of more pain, he opts to walk into the cold depths of the sea. With his escape in reach, it seems like everything will be over soon—until someone catches him. Yeo Tae-Ju, a sadistic alpha who seems to take pleasure in other’s pain, gives Eui-Hyun the choice to pay off his debt with his body but when the omega refuses, Tae-Ju proves he has no other choice.

Still desperate for escape, Eui-Hyun tries to plan his next attempt while doing restaurant work. But with a sorry paycheck that barely covers his interests and his little brother to care for, will Eui-Hyun have to sell his body after all just to survive? And, is it even worth surviving if this is what his life is meant to be?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

love-is-an-illusion-superstar.description:
Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

dangerous-convenience-store.description:
Danger can come in many shapes and sizes, and the kind of danger Yeo Eui-joon has to deal with comes in the form of buff, brash, belligerent gangsters. He knew that working nights in a shifty neighborhood wouldn’t be the safest job on the planet, but reality sure does exceed expectations. However, Eui-joon’s days as the neighborhood punching bag look like they’re coming to a close when Gunwoo steps into this small store. Gunwoo, gruff as he is, genuinely seems to care about Eui-joon’s well-being, so it doesn't take long for Eui-joon to fall for this charismatic giant.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.english: Love is an Illusion! - The Queen

love-is-an-illusion-queen.description:
Free-spirited Alpha Do-Gyeom has finally decided to put her promiscuous past behind her and settle down. As a 39-year-old woman, however, her options for marriage partners have dwindled. Luckily she has her beleaguered Omega secretary, Seung-Ah, to do most of the work of finding a suitable match for her. It shouldn’t be a problem, even if Seung-Ah and Do-Gyeom have harbored secret feelings for each other for years. In fact, arranging Do-Gyeom’s marriage may just be the catalyst for the two of them to finally admit their attraction…unless another Alpha gets in the way!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

raising-beta.description: A fragile Beta finds himself surrounded by dominant Alphas in an unpredictable omegaverse relationship.

title.romaji: Zai Ci Bei Qian Ren Ding Shang
title.english: Be Watched by My Ex Again

be-watched-by-my-ex.description: An unexpected reunion between former lovers sparks lingering obsessions and complicated feelings in this high-tension urban romance.

social-temperature.description: Song Yuanxun, an indifferent student with biases, accidentally matches on a dating app with Fang Zhaomu—someone he heavily disliked. To his surprise, Fang Zhaomu turns out to be unexpectedly endearing and persistent.

love-you-is-my-fault.description: A heart-wrenching webtoon tracing the painful sacrifices and deep emotional entanglements between two people bound by destiny.

unilaterally-married.description: Popular celebrity Li Yuze shocks the entire entertainment world by announcing right after his debut that he is already married to a man, sparking an intense mystery around his spouse He Zhiqiu.

princes-first-love.description: Flawless royal prince Nazaire transfers schools to consolidate his status, only to clash fiercely with campus tyrant Cassius Li—leading to unexpected dreams and conflicting desires.

title.romaji: Qianfu You You You Xiang Fuhunle

ex-husband-wants-to-marry-again.description: After enduring heartbreak and a messy divorce, Ji Ran leaves his regretful ex-husband Ye Linghan, who desperately chases after him to win back his heart.

title.english: Facing Off Against the Scumbag Top
title.romaji: Yu Ta Zhengmian Duijue De Rizi

days-of-confrontation-against-scum-attac.description: Yu Baoyuan bared his soul for five years but still ended up being driven away by the scumbag. Was he defeated? Impossible. Even if his entire life was a mess, Brother Yuanbao still insisted that he—the dauntless, stubborn and foxy man—was the chosen one. Hence, Brother Yuanbao did not waver when the scumbag poured his heart out to ask for forgiveness. Yuanbao stroked his cat as he drank tea and casually commented, “The weather has turned chilly, some men should be trained…"(Source: Bilibili Comics)

fatal-oxygen.description:
Su Mu, male singer, gentle as water, is now paired with the dominative president Ning Ye of a large business group. The marking of pheromone puts both men’s life at stake. However, the former boyfriend of Su Mu just came back from Germany, turning from a poor actor to an award-winning one. The love from two different men is overwhelming Su Mu. Is he going to get stuck in the middle?
(Source: Wecomics)

zero-hunting.description:
Formerly a genius hunter, Bai Mu is now a third-rate celebrity. In a moment of carelessness, he was captured by his childhood playmate who turned out to be a vampire. From then on, he found it impossible to get away from his aggressively possessive childhood friend.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ao Jiao Nai Ba Xiuxiang Tao

deliverance-of-the-counterattack.description:
Having a two-faced bitch as a rival in love isn’t scary. What’s scary is that the bitch has the upper hand—reincarnating as his little brother! Due to his little brother, his lover cheated on him, his grandfather suffered a violent death, his family business was taken over, and on top of all that he was framed and thrown into prison.

Just as he thought he’d hit bottom, he somehow got laid by a man and became pregnant on the night before his release. After he got out of prison, he came back anew; he opened a restaurant, engaged in cultivation, and made a fortune while raising his child. He lived a vibrant life, but certainly didn’t forget to seek revenge…

(Source: Webnovel)

heesu-in-class-2.description:
Hui-Su’s world revolves around Chan-Young, his best friend and secret crush. He doesn’t mind cheering Chan-Yeong from the sidelines or listening to all his girl problems. He doesn’t care if people only know him as “Chan-Yeong’s friend.” Then one day, Hui-Su starts hearing his name everywhere. On the bus, in the halls, during lunch… Turns out, there’s a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Hui-Su in Class 2 and he’ll tell you what to do!) and with that, Hui-Su suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn’t even know what to do about his own crush!

(Source: Lezhin, edited)
Note: Includes one prologue and ten side story chapters.

4-weeks-lover.description:
Straight-A student, a good social circle... Do-jun had no doubt that his campus life was going to be a breeze—until he reunites with Jae-hee, a friend he ghosted back in high school after he confessed his feelings for him. Well, their past shouldn't be that big of a deal, right? Everyone develops stupid crushes when they're in high school, and it seems like Jae-hee is over it anyway. Or at least, that's what Do-jun thought until Jae-hee offers a deal to him: "Be my boyfriend for 4 weeks!"

(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

bj-alex.description:
Every night at 10, Dong-Gyun locks himself up in his room, grabs a box of tissues, and watches a live cam boy show hosted by Alex, a BJ (broadcast jockey). Timid Dong-Gyun admires not only Alex’s ripped body, but his candor in sharing his sexual experiences with viewers. One night, Dong-Gyun downs too many drinks at a school networking event and passes out. When he wakes up, he’s in bed staring up at a shirtless hunk. A hunk who looks an awful lot like... Alex.(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

monochrome-diary.description: Yoo-Joon is a good boy. That's why he was destined to fall head-over-heels for the handsome and charismatic Ji-Ho. When Ji-Ho says "Jump," Yoo-Joon asks "How high?" And as the pair become more inseparable by the day, they solidify their master-dog dynamic. But little do they know, each boy is harboring his own dark secret. Ji-Ho, who suffers from severe apathy resulting from childhood trauma, is using Yoo-Joon as an expendable toy, and Yoo-Joon is intensely and obsessively in love with Ji-Ho. Despite that, can the two boys successfully remove each other's masks and break the cycle of abuse?(Source: Tappytoon)

outside-the-law.description:
This is a story about the “weak” defeating the strong.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

match-rate-99-percent-lovers.description:
In the world of modern omegaverse, Hae-Jin is an average office worker with a spirit of adventurer who happens to be the omega that Hwan Lee, a sharp-looking and ambitious corporate executive has been searching for. Hwan, who needs a matching omega with a sufficient compatibility rate in order to have him bear his child, offers Hae-Jin an overwhelming deal that is too sweet to be rejected.(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

Chapter count includes 6 side stories.

pian-pian.description:
In the world of "Pian Pian", people are born with the initials of their soulmates on their bodies. The location of these "imprints" is unique to the individual, but the meaning behind the letters is the same. Suha’s happens to be located in a – ahem – very private location. The chances of actually uniting with one’s soulmates is rather slim, but that hasn’t stopped Suha. Not only does he believe he will find his soulmate, but he also refuses to date anyone until then. But lately, his handsome boss, Chef Calix, has had him feeling some feels "down there..." He thought he was alone in these feelings, but the chef has suddenly started showing interest in him. Could the tides be finally changing for innocent Suha?
(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

sissy.description:
Obsessive playboy x Gentle cutie.

Ever since he was little, Li Chengxiu has faced all the difficulties life could offer, when he just wanted to be loved. Shao Qun is the heir of a wealthy family. His boisterous and unruly personality was at its worst during his high school years. From curiosity to bullying, then becoming attraction. It was the wrong time for these awkward feelings, only destined to hurt each other. They thought they'd left it behind and moved on. But when they meet again, will their encounter be the beginning of happiness or the continuation of pain?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

fall-in-love-with-the-substitute.description:
Alex is a replacement for Sebastian's crush, Eddie. He seems totally smitten with Sebastian, but really it's all an act. He's only using him for money. When Eddie is back in town and moves into Sebastian's place, the first thing he says to Alex is, "Leave Sebastian for me."(Source: WebComics)
Note: Includes four extra chapters.

personal-tailor.description:
In the original work "CEO's Personal Tailor," Song Fengshi is the manager of a luxury store and unexpectedly runs into an old classmate who is now a CEO. The next day, he wakes up to discover that he had an intimate encounter with said classmate. He fled in a panic, only to later discover that the CEO had acquired their brand and had become his new boss.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

code-of-silence.description:
The life of an assassin is many things: dangerous, lonely, short... and above all, ill-suited for love. Those were the rules Joaquin agreed to and accepted without question until the fateful day a young man named Davion saved his life. But the life of an assassin is no fairy tale. In an odd twist of fate, Joaquin ended up ripping away everything Davion held dear, and has since taken it upon himself to train the young man on how to get his revenge against everyone involved... including Joaquin himself.

(Source: Tapas)

rabid-dog-breeding-rules.description: In the eyes of Xu Hanzhou, Shen Yuan was always his most obedient, submissive, and loyal dog. But when Shen Yuan loses control and goes completely wild, Hanzhou realizes that behind that docile facade lies a dangerous, obsessive beast. A tension-filled ABO power dynamic unfolds between a cold, calculating Queen and an unhinged, fiercely devoted hound.

trap-a-vicious-dog.description:
Shi Qi, a lawyer who died from overwork, transmigrated into a multi-partner novel, becoming the scumbag top who pushed Feng Ran into darkness. Out of respect for the law, Shi Qi decideds to spare the pitiful Feng Ran from the story's plot. However, Shi Qi didn't expect that the original canary would be reborn and blacken, approaching him with the anger and resentment of his past life, causing him to fall and become prey. But in the end, it was the vengeful Feng Ran who cried uncontrollably. "Shi Qi, please love me again." It turns out that the hunter and the prey were destined from the very beginning of the story…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

killer-crush.description:
A killer only has to do three things. Go on missions. Kill people. Leave absolutely no trace behind. Joo Tae-Man has 14 years of experience under his belt and he’s never let his feelings get the better of him. Never. That is, until Tae-Man experiences butterflies in his stomach after seeing national sweetheart Kang Da-Hyeok in person. But as it turns out, Tae-Man’s not the only one smitten on the spot. Da-Hyeok’s been looking for someone who can help him escape his reputation as a hunky heartthrob to live his gritty noir dreams. This killer crush’s out to get someone, but who’ll be the first to succumb? 

(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Jiazhuang Shiyi Hou Qingdi Shuo Wo Shi Ta De Nanpengyou
title.native: 假装失忆后情敌说我是他的男朋友

alphas-love-charade.description: Can two rival Alphas end up as a couple? Ask Cloud Ling, who gets hit by a car while escaping loan sharks. The driver? None other than his ex-rival, Marius Ji! Their journey from childhood friends to estranged rivals takes a dramatic turn when Cloud feigns amnesia to avoid an awkward reunion, only for Marius to insist that they're boyfriends! As Cloud grapples with this bizarre claim, he wonders: Is this mishap a stroke of luck, reigniting a long-lost bond, or are some chapters best left closed?(Source: Tapas)

zhong-qing.description:
The low-level guide Qin Yun was forcibly marked by the god-level sentinel tyrant Mosheli. The hot-tempered girl-hearted top x the serious and honest bottom started a shameless life as a couple, and conquered the entire universe while they're at it.(Source: Bilibili, translated)
Note: Includes two extra chapters.

semantic-error.description:
A Bug in the System
Reason, routine, and rules. These are the tenets that computer science major Sang-Woo Chu lives by, so when the rest of his teammates fail to contribute to their group’s presentation, he cuts their names from the project—including that of a complete no-show, whose plans to graduate and study abroad have gone down the drain as a result. Not that that’s any of Sang-Woo’s business…until he realizes that Jae-Young Jang, the talented design major he was hoping to hire for his video game, is: one, that very same classmate, and two, hell-bent on returning the favor and being the biggest thorn in his side! Will Sang-Woo be able to debug this semantic error before it upends his entire life?(Source: Yen Press, edited)
Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

punch-drunk-love.description:
Seon-woo is a pretty unassuming office worker, but he’s got a hardcore fetish: he wants some BDSM love from another man who’s willing to dominate. Enter his new co-worker, Tae-moon. Tae-moon is really hot, and based on a little snooping, he might be into men–and he’s showing signs of being a dom, to boot! Trying to start a sexy relationship at work can be rough, but Seon-woo likes it rough, so game on.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

dont-get-me-wrong-boss.description:
Lim Iro is a BL writer, and a pretty successful one at that! His last project was lavished with praise by everyone… Well, almost everyone. Under pressure from his unimpressed parents, Iro is forced into applying for a “real” job. But instead of a cover letter, he accidentally submits an unreleased extract from his book instead! Disaster! Or maybe not…? Faced with Iro’s unconventional application, Baek Ho-ryung, the dashing CEO of Beus drinks company, is intrigued. But once Iro joins Beus, will his office life begin to emulate his steamy writing…?

(Source: Lezhin)

juanmuqi.description:
Emperor Yi Yeon is famous throughout the kingdom of Hochang for his outstanding political prowess and ruthless attitude towards sycophants. After relentlessly bullying his palace cleaners into fainting on the job, junior eunuch Yoo Yak-woo is called upon to fulfill the cleaning duties, which he enjoys to the point of being nicknames Sogwija, aka “the cleaning demon”. Immediately, this young, fresh-faced eunuch and his delectably juicy buttocks catch the emperor’s eye. One night, Yi yeon calls Yoo Yak-woo to his room for a very “special” cleaning service and the shenanigans begin to unfold…

(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes five extra chapters.

omega-complex.description:
Yoon-Woo and Tae-Gyeom have been best friends since childhood, but Yoon-Woo is hiding a secret that could tear them apart–he’s an omega… and he’s in love with Tae-Gyeom.

When a traumatic event leads Tae-Gyeom to despise all omegas, Yoon-Woo is forced to keep his identity a secret. After struggling for years to avoid Tae-Gyeom, they both end up at the same college, and Yoon-Woo’s carefully guarded secret is in danger of being exposed…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

b-class-guide.description:
A dizzying office love affair between an S-class esper and a B-class guide! Lee Jaeha, a B-class guide, had an office relationship with an esper at the same center for 3 years, but was recently done wrong. Despite breaking up with his lover, he finds himself forced to still guide him, and he applies for a transfer to a high-risk area. Surrounded by all kinds of rumors and stares, all he wants is a quiet and peaceful work life in the new center! However, Jaeha takes on the task of guiding Do Jiyoon, an S-class esper, on the verge of a rampage, and Jaeha’s work life is getting farther away from peaceful…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

butler.description:
How are you supposed to go about your workday when your secret crush, a sexy CEO with amber eyes, lives in the hotel you work at? What’s worse: you’re his personal butler! Ian Seo lives this every day, watching the alpha of his dreams bringing home guy after guy, not even sparing him a second glance. But determination gets the best of Ian and he formulates a plan to make CEO Jaek-Won Yoo his. Can he woo the cold and distant alpha, or is Ian destined to be just the butler for the rest of his life?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 28 extra chapters.

cozy-obsession.description:
Huimin Seo happened to read a tragic BL novel where the two main characters had both his name and even his best friend’s name, Iheon Cha. But rather than remaining as an incredible coincidence, this book becomes a new reality for Huimin. Before he knows it, he is transmigrated right into a major scene in the novel where Huimin Seo, a rare dominant omega, gets bought off in an auction by Iheon Cha, a powerful dominant alpha. Aware of the complications in this love-hate relationship that he cannot escape from, Huimin must tread carefully to turn things around entirely.

(Source: Tappytoon)
Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

no-love-zone.description:
It’s been about a year since Lee Eun-Kyum started working at his office job. He’s outgoing and gets along well with his co-workers, but his success with romantic relationships is less than stellar, especially since he tends to fall hard and fast based on looks alone. History seems poised to repeat itself in the form of his new boss, Han Ji-Hyuk.

The handsome Han Ji-Hyuk is exactly Lee Eun-Kyum’s type, but his personality is a total turn-off as he proceeds to work Lee Eun-Kyum to the bone. The more aggravated Lee Eun-Kyum feels, the more he can’t get Han Ji-Hyuk off his mind. Could this heated attraction be mutual?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)
Note: Includes one extra chapter.

unromantic-romance.description:
In a world where Omegas rule supreme, it’s tough being an Alpha. But Hyeon-oh’s been able to lead a decent, if a little boring, life so far and it seems like things'll stay that way. He’ll graduate from university, get a job as a reporter, meet an Omega who’ll take care of him, start a family with them and live happily ever after. The perfect romance. The kind of romance that starts when you ask the bartender to make a drink for the only other person in the bar. Little does Hyeon-oh know how that innocent gesture will pull him headfirst into the most unromantic of situations...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue, an extra scene included in one of the author note's and 10 extra chapters.

boss-bitch-baby.description:
Would you rather be the target of a ruthless gang of loan sharks or become the boy-toy of an unhinged corporate heir for a year? This is the predicament Hojin finds himself in when Yoo-Seong, a former one-night stand, wrestles him into a deal that’ll solve all his money problems. He’ll have to pay a hefty price in return, but Hojin soon comes to learn that his cruel master for a year hides a rather lonely heart. Thus, the two begin to grow closer... Will they actually find comfort in each other or will this year crush Ho-Jin for good? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 34 extra chapters.

can-angels-do-this.description:
Hyeon-Jin is a devil—literally. But not a very well-fed one. Without a proper source of spiritual energy, he’s constantly starving. At a broadcast station party, his luck finally seems to turn when two smoking-hot celebrities—top actor Seon-Wu and elite model Ha-Jun—start flirting with him. Jackpot, right? Desperate, Hyeon-Jin gives in, hoping to drain a little energy and dash. Except…
“You're a demon, aren't you?”
Uh-oh. Turns out Seon-Wu and Ha-Jun are actually angels. Sexy, powerful, and way too smug about it. Instead of smiting him, they offer Hyeon-Jin a deal he can't refuse—one that involves lots of close contact, a suspicious amount of cuddling, and... were those feathers?? Now stuck between two heavenly bodies with very unholy intentions, Hyeon-Jin wonders: Since when were angels this into corrupting demons?!(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ないしょのストーカーさん

my-secret-stalker.description: Sumiya is a resilient, hardworking, and gentle person, so he’s often pushed to do a lot of work. He has this certain “secret”. He is living strangely with someone he can't see. When he comes home completely exhausted, there’s a hot bath and meal prepared for him. And at night… “He” comes to his side and holds him. Sumiya feels so perfectly supported in everything, from housework to letting our sexual frustrations that it feels like he can’t live without “him” anymore...!

marigold-dilemma.description:
Kwon Ga-Eul, the younger brother who always lets someone with a similar face to his brother into his room. The only one who has not been able to enter his room is his step-brother Seo Yi-Sol who lives with him. "Can you sleep with me? If you don't want to, then don't cross the line."
It has been 6 years since Ga-Eul was unable to cross the line drawn by him, and Yi-Sol wants to cross that line.(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

jinx.description:
Physical therapist Kim Dan has been down on his luck for as long as he can remember. Between an ailing grandmother, menacing loansharks, and an old boss making it almost impossible for him to find work, Dan is truly running out of options. Naturally, it feels like a dream come true when he’s finally hired to treat top-paid MMA fighter Joo Jae-kyung, especially when the man then calls him out for a treatment the night before a match with an oh-so-tantalizing offer of five thousand dollars. He claims to have a “jinx” in need of a particular type of “treatment," but it's one that Dan isn't quite prepared to offer… You see, Jae-kyung may be a beast in the ring, but he’s even rougher in the bedroom, and Dan’s not sure he can survive Jae-kyung at his most primal. Nevertheless, the promise of much-needed cash has Dan agreeing to this ill-fated deal... Could a night together be the thing to help Jae-kyung break this jinx once and for all?

(Source: Lezhin US)

cheating-a-hidden-ending.description: After beating "The Return of the D-Rank Hunter," the game, Seon-Woo wakes up as the game's NPC, kidnapped by the insomnia-ridden protagonist Jae-Hwi, who demands Seon-Woo become his Mentalist via a one-sided contract. To return to reality, Seon-Woo must unlock the game’s secret ending. Will he make it?(Source: Manta)

secrets-of-omega-k.description:
A dream romance between the sIn a society where people are in tune with their genetics, Hajin Kim was born as a recessive Omega, but he’s is in love with a dominant Alpha named Soohyuk Cha. For seven years, Hajin watches Soohyuk from a distance until one day, he overhears that Soohyuk will soon be leaving to study abroad. As a farewell, Hajin vows to sleep with Soohyuk. Despite learning certain dark details about Soohyuk’s character, Hajin makes a choice in a moment of desperation and madness. And now Soohyuk is on the prowl, looking for him. Is this Alpha trying to destroy Hajin, or... has something else taken root? Something like love?
(Source: Lezhin US)

second-time-of-dawn.description:
For the past ten years, Baek Ha-Yeon has been living in guilt for ruining the life of his love, Yoon Yi-Han. Because of this, he feels he has no right to object when Yi-Han wishes to continue their relationship despite getting married. At the same time, Yi-Han’s cousin, Yoon Jin-Woon, has been using their secret as leverage to get Ha-Yeon to sleep with him since he also has feelings for him. 

Just when the lives of these three seem to have gotten so irreversibly tangled, Ha-Yeon is sent ten years into the past before the biggest regret of his life occurred. Though he is determined to alter the course of this timeline and save Yi-Han’s life, he wants to keep ignoring Jin-Woon’s blatant feelings for him. 

However, when Jin-Woon offers to help Ha-Yeon avoid the very cause of his problem, the two become entwined all over again…

(Source: Tappytoon)
Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.english: Didi Kan Wo de Yanshen Rijian Xiee
title.romaji: Didi Kan Wo de Yanshen Rijian Xiee
title.native: 弟弟看我的眼神日渐邪恶

give-me-a-brush.description: Cheng Quian loved art, so he entered the prestigious Academy of Arts despite his family's opposition. Penniless, he works to support his studies, and he meets Xu Qiujin, who is his exact opposite. Despite their differences, Cheng Quian and Xu Qiujin can't seem to get enough of each other. (Source: INKR)

title.english: A Hundred Ways to Save A Soul Splitter
title.romaji: Zhengjiu Jing Fen De Yibai Zhong Fangfa
title.native: 拯救精分的一百种方法

100-ways-to-heal-a-psychopath.description:
Tang Dongbao, who was just about to become a deity, had to take on a mission: Save the grand deity Xiao Yi who split his soul because his divinity was too strong. However, Xiao Yi killed Dongbao in the first world! How am I supposed to save you, my soul-splitting target?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

minmotion-syndrome.description:
“I’ll repay that 450 thousand for you…but in exchange, you’re mine.”
 
Due to the debt left behind by his father, alpha Seo Taeyoon is at the mercy of Park Jae-in, a mob boss with a penchant for violence. But when Taeyoon is able to identify Jae-in as an omega by scent alone, the ruthless criminal is taken aback – because nobody should be able to smell his pheromones. 

Seeing this as his opportunity to regain what once was lost, Jae-in offers to pay off Taeyoon’s father’s loan in exchange for a life of servitude. Now Jae-in holds the key to both the physical and metaphorical locks around Taeyoon’s neck. And so begins their relationship as master and slave...but there's no telling how it will end.

(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes 25 extra chapters.

night-of-london.description:
Martin Scofield’s a lone werewolf who was born a highly breedable “snow.” To avoid being used, he spent years on the run, taking odd jobs to survive. On the other hand, Daniel Sinclair was lovingly raised by two phantom vampires until a certain hunter killed them in cold blood and left him orphaned. When the two unknowingly reunite centuries later, Martin’s mission to avoid love and Daniel’s mission to avenge the only love he knew get sidelined as something much deeper develops between them.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Nali Lai De Da Bao Bei

whose-baby-is-it.description:
According to the fortune-teller, I was born to be unlucky...was he kidding me?! My child owns the super power that can turn calamities into blessings through dreams! But the bossy president suddenly claimed that he's the natural father of my babe?! And he even kidnapped me and my child?!

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Ai Yu Sha Yi Zhi Ye

kill-my-love.description:
Ten years ago, the beta was at his peak as a hit-man, when he was seriously injured while trying to save an alpha child. Having lost his edge as a killer, he retired to the countryside with a new identity to start a new life. Until an unexpected visitor showed up one day. That boy he saved has grownup to become the leader of his own gang, and now he's come looking for him with crazed intentions.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: Two Empires: A Tale of One Slave

two-empires-slave-of-the-empire.description:
Murdered in cold blood, Emperor Levenoad of Strahss is reincarnated as a slave named Ray in the enemy empire of El Fascher! To make matters worse, he's caught the eye of the emperor, Jiskar, and gets dragged off to the palace as his concubine. In order to escape, Ray must spread his legs for Jiskar in order to win his favor, all while carefully avoiding the jealous, power-hungry empress and crown prince who will do anything to tear him down. More importantly, he must figure out who killed him in his past life... and why. Unfortunately, none of this will prove to be easy with guards at his side 24/7 and his feet in shackles. Will Ray be able to find freedom while uncovering the truth about his past? Or is he doomed to be forever chained in the palace of the enemy empire?

(Sourde: Tappytoon)

dont-mess-with-the-puppy.description:
Life sure is ruff, especially when you’re Gyeon Hui-Seong. Abandoned by his pack of fellow dog shifters, he is forced to become a drug runner for a gambling ring. For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yun Chi-Young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form…a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Hui-Seong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. Will Hui-Seong be able to escape the ruthless, terrifying outpour of love Chi-Young showers him with and escape his criminal past? Or will he be forever leashed to a life of kibble and kennels?
(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.english: My Egocentric Boss is Obsessed With Me

my-egocentric-boss-is-obsessed-with-me.description:
For the chronically single and overworked Soohan, thirsting over his boss's firm booty is his greatest guilty pleasure. It's sad and pathetic, but after a long string of lousy exes and an even longer dry spell, the handsome and talented Mr. Woo seems just that much hotter. Sure, he comes with blazing red flags like his egocentric personality, his bizarre preferences, and his sadistic tendency to overwork his employees. But as off-putting as these qualities are, they aren't enough to deter Soohan's massive crush - especially when the man keeps calling him "babe" and giving him special attention outside the office. Why on earth is his demonic yet charming boss asking him to pick out his bedroom sheets and cooking him his favorite dinner when they aren't even dating? Though he doesn't want to get his hopes up, Soohan can't help but wonder whether his self-centered boss is actually obsessed with him...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: includes six extra chapters.

the-moon-comes-to-me.description:
In his third year of junior high, Tao Xi learned about his fate of being deliberately swapped at birth by his "mother." He lived his days in a daze until, on the remote live-stream screen of a poor county high school, he saw Lin Qinhe from the prestigious Wenhua High School thousands of kilometers away.

For him, living at the bottom of a well, it was the first glimpse of the moon in the sky.

But when he exhausted all his strength to climb out of the well and trekked through mountains and rivers towards the moon, he discovered that the star beside the moon was originally meant to be his place.

Tao Xi wanted Lin Qinhe, along with the missing affection that should have been his.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: The S-Class Guide as Sweet as Honey

s-class-guide-as-sweet-as-honey.description: Jin Hyoseop is an S-class guide whose powers leave him aroused and smelling as sweet as honey. In order to hide his embarrassing secret, he joins a C-class guild on the condition that he only does the minimum guiding required to heal his esper guildmates. It shouldn’t be an issue since the guild’s kind and understanding commander Andante assures him that they don’t handle any dangerous jobs. But then, why does everyone keep coming back injured and in desperate need of guiding? Little does Hyoseop know that he has just stepped into a lair of criminal S-class espers!(Source: Tappytoon)

possessed-by-a-cotton-ball.description:
When Yul finds himself dropped into a BL novel, reincarnated as a stuffed toy that has ended up in the hands of an obsessive, tyrannical duke, he's sure he is done for. If the truth gets out, Yul will be burned at the stake! Can he find a way to get back to his real body or is he doomed to be stuck in this fantasy land?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.romaji: Bu Nuli Jiuyao Dang Huang Fu

evenly-matched-love.description:
“If the Aslan family knew other genes had “invaded” their bloodline, they might hurt your twins!”

Magic, mecha, mana, demon foxes, and space travel. There’s a lot that’s unique about Mu Yunshen’s world. Most interestingly... for a select few men, pregnancy is also a possibility. Of course, Mu Yunshen doesn’t know about this last little detail—yet. After he saves the life of young master Aslan and spends the night with him, Mu Yunshen ends up with the shock of his life: twins.

(Source: Comikey)

salty-lust.description:
Saying bye-bye to Earth and blasting off to school in space was a dream come true for Nux. But no one told him how mediocre he would seem stacked up against the brightest minds in the universe. With lackluster grades that could never afford him a scholarship, he's forced into illegal part-time work just to pay the bills. But when a handsome alien propositions him with an offer to make his money problems disappear, he realizes it comes at an astronomical price.

(Source: Tappytoon)

double-faced-anchor.description:
The excellent game player is a part-time model in real life?! The senior he respects most is his hard-core fan?! His double identity is going to be exposed... What should he do? Admit it or guard the secret with his life?

(Source: Webnovel)

stop-bothering-me-emperor.description: Song Xiao only wanted to be a man of virtue, but somehow ended up being forced into a marriage with his Highness, plotted by the cunning emperor himself. However, just as the generation of great businesses began to flourish, the emperor died... When Song Xiao opened his eyes again, he finds himself in a college entrance exam... but why does his seatmate look so familiar?!(Source: Bilibili Comics)

my-four-masters.description: Xiang Nan, who's an absolute idiot when it comes to love, has had a crush on Hong Xiao for a very long time. In order to increase his eligibility as a boyfriend, he decides to seek help online from the top four male gods of the internet. "Masters, please teach me about love!" What surprises him the most is how all four of them say yes immediately. Number One says, "Overbearing CEO, Contract Lover, which one do you want to be?" Number Two says, "Midnight shower, personal bedroom, which one do you want a peek at?" Number Three says, "Kneeling, squatting, sideways, and prone. Which way do you want to be positioned?" Number Four says, "Chest muscles, abdominal muscles, pelvic muscles, which one do you wanna train first?" Erm...why is this path to knowledge filled with so many obstacles?(Source: Bilibili Comics)

red-mansion.description:
A dilapidated mansion sits on the outskirts of Seoul. Among its residents are frauds, murderers, and psychopaths, all seeking refuge in the only place that will accept them. But not every resident of the run-down manor has come here by choice. Kim Sungkyung operates a minimart so that he can afford to take care of his parents, who have come down with a malignant disease. Having been born inside the four walls of the mansion, a life of depravity and deprivation is all he knows. The sole thing that gets him through is his obsession with the building's manager, Kwon Cheong-rim: a cruel and calculating figure seemingly only interested in the preservation of his own wealth and power. So when the enigmatic pretty boy begins to hint at a sort of faint interest in Sungkyung, the latter's obsession begins to grow as a single question echoes ceaselessly throughout his mind: "Why...?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

sacred-serpents-seduction.description: How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Tae-Sun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Tae-Sun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Tae-Sun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Tae-Sun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…? (Source: Lezhin US)Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

ordinary-person-a.description:
Ordinary civilian Howoo's day turns into a disaster movie when a giant monster ambushes his city. All he hopes for is a quick and painless death, so he's pleasantly surprised when he's whisked out of harm's way by celebrity esper Yool. When the charming esper moves in next door shortly after, Howoo feels like he's living in a romcom. Not only does Yool know Howoo's name, but he also shows an oddly friendly interest in him when he's just one of the many civilians he's saved. And for some reason, Howoo feels a tingling sensation whenever their hands touch...

(Source: Tappytoon)

living-with-mr-predator.description:
I just want a male mother! College student Song Fu, had 3 babies overnight and fell into a [child-rearing hell] — In order to solve this problem, he decided to hire a professional nanny. However, to his surprise, the person knocking on the door turned out to be a [Super tall, muscular bodied] man?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes five extras.

chen-shang.description: The scar on my lower abdomen is an old wound that has been difficult to heal over the years.(Source: Bilibili Comics)

release-your-persona.description:
As a top-tier film star, Jae-Gyu is no stranger to the spotlight or the toxic rumors that follow it. Exhausted by the public eye, he has become a professional at pushing people away. That changes when he meets his neighbor, Cheong-Rok, a counselor at a psychiatry office. Cheong-Rok does not recognize the star and treats him like anyone else. Intrigued by this normal treatment, Jae-Gyu finds himself drawn to the one man unimpressed by his fame. Despite his long career, Jae-Gyu has never experienced romance, not even through a script. So is he finally ready for the real thing?
(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

blood-lust.description:
Medical examiner and virgin Han Yeonu's suspects that his corpse is the victim of a homosexual serial killing. He tries to inform Cha Dohyeon, the district attorney in charge of the case, but in the process almost becomes a victim himself. Dohyeon offers Yeonu to stay with him as the killer is on the loose. While together, the two start unleashing the lust they'd suppressed ever since their first encounter, as Dohyeon takes the lead and Yeonu finds comfort in his arms.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes 13 side stories.

salt-friend.description:
School bully Tong Yang gets suspended after a fight on the first day of school. When he returns, everyone fears and avoids him. One day, top student Xiao Zhen catches him secretly crying—and when Tong Yang tries to scare him into silence, Xiao Zhen fights back instead. Cold and distant to everyone else, Xiao Zhen suddenly starts tutoring Tong Yang. But when Tong Yang discovers the boy he fought on the first day was actually Xiao Zhen's younger brother, everything between them gets a whole lot more complicated.


(Source: WebComics)

Note: The series was originally self-published on Jing Jian’s Weibo blog. Currently releasing on Kuaikan Manhua and Bilibili Manhua since July 31, 2021.

lights-camera-action.description:
Actor Geum Ki-Yool has been secretly in love with his roommate Seo-Moon Hyung since their school days. When Ki-Yool takes on an adult-themed music video, he tries to set the mood by experimenting with a toy, only to get caught in the act by Hyung himself! But instead of being shocked, Hyung unexpectedly offers to help him out. As the lines between fiction and reality begin to blur, both Ki-Yool and Hyung have to find the courage to step into the spotlight. (Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

senza-replica.description:
Dowon chose to be a freelance guide for the freedom to do other things, but his cold and demanding esper, Kwonwoo, calls him for guiding every day without fail. Although he thinks he has his hands full already, he's proven wrong when Kwonwoo loses eight years of his memories and his powers due to an accident on the job. Now it's up to Dowon to restore both by giving the mentally 20-year-old Kwonwoo the kind of intimate guiding he always refused before. But surprisingly, this cheery and affectionate Kwonwoo seems all too eager to take things to the next level...

(Source: Tappytoon)
Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

please-pay-attention-to-me.description:
The new semester is buzzing with students eager to make friends. Nam Soo-Min, however, has only one goal: survive the year without getting dragged into anyone’s business. Enter Lee Jae-Ha, the ultimate social butterfly and Soo-Min’s brand-new classmate and roommate. For someone like Jae-Ha, being ignored is unthinkable. And Soo-Min? He just made the mistake of catching his eye. Try as he might to escape, Soo-Min finds himself tangled up in Jae-Ha’s wild orbit.

“How much longer are you gonna ignore me? Give me some attention!”
It’s the unstoppable force of popularity versus the immovable wall of indifference... and the semester has only just begun!(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes one extra chapter.

part-time-partner.description:
Kyu-Ho has become smitten with new club member, Yun-Geon. Not only is Yun-Geon’s face gorgeous but there’s something about the way he stands his ground confidently. As the two classmates get to know each other, Kyu-Ho starts falling for Yun-Geon even harder. But when, out of the blue, Yun-Geon says, “you’re not my style,” to Kyu-Ho, the two start a love-hate relationship for the ages.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

ring.description: Choi Yoonjae unexpectedly finds the wedding ring of a gangster boss/hyung named Kang Sungho. Instead of returning it immediately, he impulsively keeps it, trapping himself in an intense, dangerous, and obsessive dynamic.

title.english: My Gangster Wife Is Always Against Me
title.romaji: Wo De Heidao Laopo Zong He Wo Duizhegan
title.native: 我的黑道老婆总和我对着干

my-gangster-wife-is-always-against-me.description: A dynamic omegaverse BL story featuring high-conflict crime/underworld elements, where a stubborn partner is combative and always at odds with the main lead before their fierce dynamic turns to devotion.

the-yandere-top-father-is-being-teased.description:
“What role did I play in this novel? I want to know what kind of relationship I had with Chae Seung-Yeon.”

Seung-Yeon is possessed by the father of the obsessive maniac in the run-down BL novel written by his younger sister. Woo-Jin, the father of the main character, saves Seung-Yeon when he is in danger of death. Seung-Yeon realizes that he and Woo-Jin are in-laws, but as time passes, their relationship somehow flows differently from the original story…

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

what-about-me-besides-my-wife.description:
Yin Tae-Rim, CEO of a failing company, turns to Seo Yi-Rin, a powerful executive with a reputation for sponsoring the lovers she takes a liking to. Desperate to save his business, he makes his move, but Yi-Rin already has a new “puppy” to play with and shows no interest. Instead, she passes him along. Not to a colleague. Not to a rival. To her husband.

That’s how Tae-Rim ends up in front of Jin Ha-Kyung, the cold and unreadable head of a major company. Ha-Kyung listens, watching him squirm through an awkward explanation. Then, with a slow smile tugging at his lips, he makes a proposal that stops Tae-Rim cold.

"Forget my wife. Try me."

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Love History Caused by Willful Negligence

love-history-caused-by-willful-negligenc.description:
Woo-Yeon is one of the brightest rising stars as a nationally beloved actor. Nobody is capable of hating such a talented and sweet man with his blessed looks. Or, well, that’s what people who don’t know the real Woo-Yeon think. In reality, Woo-Yeon is manipulative, cold-hearted, and dangerous. But his new manager In-Seob is his biggest fan, and he’s determined to stick by Woo-Yeon’s side no matter what. Except…remember how nobody in the know is capable of hating Woo-Yeon? Well, In-Seob just might know more than he lets on…

(Source: Lezhin US)

can-a-gangster-leave-a-gang.description: Hyeongwon, a member of the Viper Gang, decides to leave the gang and flee the country. He still has a long way to go, but in a weak moment, he ends up having a one-night stand with  Seongjin... But who is really Seongjin?

murderous-lewellyns-candlelit-dinner.description:
Life on rough, rundown Ira Street isn’t easy at the best of times, but a recent string of murders has left the residents traumatized. Not Shavonne, though. He’s too busy trying to get by to worry about some murderer. However, that all changes when he meets his peculiar new neighbor. Lewellyn is young and handsome, yet eccentric. Why does he spend all day peeling onions on the apartment stairs until his eyes are red-raw? And what’s with those filthy black fingernails? Nevertheless, Shavonne reluctantly accepts a dinner invitation at his neighbor’s place. But after he makes a gruesome discovery during the candlelit meal, suddenly the murders feel a lot closer to home…

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Zai Ci Bei Qian Ren Ding Shang
title.english: Be Watched by My Ex Again

be-watched-by-my-ex-again.description: An unexpected reunion between former lovers sparks lingering obsessions and complicated feelings in this high-tension urban romance.

flower-and-the-beast.description:
"Could this all perhaps be Hwayeon's dream? Or did Yeonu create this fantasy world in her head to escape her harsh reality?"
Hwayeon Ryu, without knowing the cause, falls into a coma at the age of six. Then after 12 long years of her father, Chung Ryu's persistent attempts, she finally opens her eyes. As she wakens from her prolonged sleep, she realizes she not only has her memories but has the memories of someone else's life, Yeonu Lee. Though startled at first, as time passes, she manages to adjust to her new life. Then one day, in hope to have lunch with her father, she pays a visit to the palace. But she ends up taking the wrong turn and finds herself in front of the notorious beast, crown prince Muyeong...
The story unfolds then, when the soft and delicate flower Hwayeon meets the arrogant and fearless beast, Muyeong.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes 32 extra chapters.

kiss-sixth-sense.description:
Ye-Sul Hong has a secret – when she kisses someone, she can see flashes of their future. It’s hard to believe she’s ever met the right guy when she can’t even see herself in their destiny. She doesn’t get much use out of her ability until one day, when she accidentally kisses her evil boss, Min-Hu Cha, who’s got a secret of his own. To her utter shock, she sees a vision of herself… in bed with him! As if that’s not confusing enough, she shows up to work the next day to find out that her first love has been hired to work in her department. Will she be able to survive working with the man she wished had been her destiny and the man she’s destined to be with?
(Source: WEBTOONS)

if-ai-ruled-the-world.description:
Welcome to a world where artificial intelligence can drive your car, look after you when you’re ill, and solve all of your problems. But all of this convenience comes at a price. AI can pose a threat when it no longer has humanity’s best interests at heart. Can humans learn to coexist with AI?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

actually-i-was-the-real-one.description:
A prophecy foretold that the Grand Duke would only have one water elementalist born from him. Though she lacks her father’s affection, Keira knows she’s destined for those powers. But after years of doing what was right and proper of a noble, she’s executed after the conniving Cosette appears, claiming to be the Grand Duke’s real daughter. But then—Keira wakes up with newfound purpose: make changes, allies, and even friends before it’s too late. Will it be enough before Cosette hatches her plot?

(Source: Tapas)

who-made-me-a-princess.description:
The story of Athanasia, forsaken princess of the Obelian Empire, ends with her execution at the hands of her own father—or does it? Her tragic tale is the plot of the novel The Lovely Princess. But now, a modern woman who read the book has just woken up as baby Athanasia herself, filled with her own memories and knowledge of the story she’s stuck in! Determined to survive her doomed fate, infant Athanasia embarks on this new life with a plan: avoid attention and hoard valuables to fund her escape. When her plan goes awry, she suddenly needs to charm her way into the good graces of her father, the beautiful tyrant emperor, so he doesn’t kill her again!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Chongsheng Kongjian: Haomen La Qi Buhaore
title.native: 重生空间：豪门辣妻不好惹

spicy-wifes-reborn-world.description:
She was the successor to a great healer, yet her reincarnation is a meek shadow of a girl. Call her stupid? Her alchemy and medical skills will stun skeptics! Laugh at her misfortune? She'll deal with her vicious stepmother and sister with a wave of her hand! All she wants after her reincarnation is vengeance and to live her life, but little does she know that she has caught the attention of the most noble man in the country. Her kiss-and-run scheme is thwarted because she's been captured against her will. "All actions have consequences, girl. Did no one teach you that?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

miss-scum-slayer-reborn.description:
What are you gonna do after getting reborn? Getting payback from my enemies, of course! Two-timer? Evil wench? I won't let anyone go! Handsome rich guy? I... won't let him go either!

(Source: Webcomics)

the-naive-mr-lu.description:
Dressed as a man, she is a lady killer with a perfect smile. Her motto is "Both women and men will fall for you as long as you work hard". Women like her. Men are so obsessed with her that they are willing to be un-straight. The uncrowned king Zong Jize sees her as his bro, but tricks her onto his bed!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Cheng Le Fan Pai Da Lao De Xiao Jiao Qi?!
title.native: 我成了反派大佬的小娇妻？！

i-became-the-villains-wife.description:
The dainty idol Chen Congong unluckily fell into a trap and awoke to a stunning naked man in her bed! Hahaha, I don't mind ending up with such a beautiful man?
Hang on...
Are you telling me I've switched places with the toxic, evil, and manipulative side character who won’t even survive 20% of the plot?! No, I'm definitely not ready to die!! Watch as I keep on living my ideal life!

(Source: QQ, translated)

title.english: My Boyfriend Got Me Falling in Love

this-boy-got-me-falling-hard.description:
A hot shot in the entertainment industry with a rookie actor? A greasy CEO and an internet celebrity falling in love? No, this is about the sweet love between a stunning lady boss and a popular up-and-coming actor!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

queen-cecias-shorts.description:
With 99 nations conquered and the cup of the ruler in her hands... you'd think she was off to a heroic conquest, but the great queen's Cecia's real concern was her uncomfortable corset?

The queen of Valencia suffered from complicated laces and heavy corsets, and thus ordered her trusted brother, Duke Ennon Lionheart to bring her a comfortable clothes.
